summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the new Account Settings dashboard at /dashboard/me + Logout modal + regression on dashboard/marketing/auth routes. All 30 test cases passed using Playwright via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardLayout calls getProfile() during render which (1) reads localStorage on every render (cheap but unnecessary) and (2) seeds defaults when not present — fine; consider lifting to a small useEffect/useState so avatar updates from ProfileTab can re-render the sidebar immediately (currently sidebar will not reflect a renamed profile until layout remounts). Low priority.
Account.jsx URL sync effect depends only on `active` (eslint disabled). If user manually changes ?tab= in URL, state won't react. Acceptable for current flow.

LogoutDialog uses setTimeout 500ms for spinner UX — fine for mock, but mention that real auth integration should debounce/cancel on rapid Cancel clicks (the cancel button is disabled during pending so currently safe).
ProfileTab uses JSON.stringify equality for `dirty` check — works for simple objects but is fragile. Consider field-level comparison.
seed_data_creation: None. localStorage seeded by app on first access (addresses, sessions).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Account dashboard flows verified end-to-end: default tab is profile with URL ?tab=profile, all 6 desktop tabs (testids account-tab-{id}-btn) and 6 mobile pills (account-tab-{id}-btn-mobile) work and sync URL, ProfileTab edit→save persists to bincycle:profile and survives reload, NotificationsTab toggles persist to bincycle:notifications, SecurityTab and BillingTab render (BillingTab shows INV- invoices), LogoutDialog opens via sidebar-signout, cancel closes it, confirm clears localStorage and navigates to /login. Mobile viewport 390 shows pill bar + topbar-signout. Regression routes all load: /dashboard/overview, /dashboard/book-pickup, /dashboard/pickups, /dashboard/pickups/:id, /, /about, /pricing, /help, /contact, /privacy-policy, /terms-of-service, /login, /register, /forgot-password, /reset-password. No backend involved (strictly frontend-only with localStorage as per requirements).
